entity.name: Valithor Obsidion
entity.description: Independent open-source developer. Owner and maintainer of the DiscordPHP ecosystem — the async PHP library for building Discord bots on ReactPHP (github.com/discord-php/DiscordPHP), its HTTP and rate-limit transport (DiscordPHP-Http), its voice stack with Opus and DAVE end-to-end encryption (DiscordPHP-Voice), plus the TwitchPHP family and several smaller libraries and bots. Everything is MIT-licensed and used in production by other people filing real issues. Sponsorship is the entire funding model: there is no paid tier and no open-core plan. Funding pays for the unglamorous half of maintenance — issue triage, release chores, keeping up with Discord and Twitch API breakage, dependency and security updates, and documentation.

projects.name: DiscordPHP
projects.description: The async PHP library for building Discord bots, built on ReactPHP. Full gateway and REST coverage, an event-driven model, and a large ecosystem of downstream bots and libraries.

projects.name: DiscordPHP-Http
projects.description: The standalone async HTTP and rate-limit layer DiscordPHP talks to Discord through — request queueing, bucket rate-limiting, and typed errors. Reusable outside DiscordPHP.

projects.name: DiscordPHP-Voice
projects.description: Voice send and receive for DiscordPHP, including Opus audio and DAVE end-to-end encryption.

projects.name: TwitchPHP
projects.description: Async Twitch framework for PHP, built like DiscordPHP: Helix REST, EventSub over WebSocket, and IRC chat.

projects.name: TwitchPHP-Http
projects.description: The standalone Helix transport for TwitchPHP — async request queue, points rate-limiting, and typed errors.

projects.name: DiscordPHP-EventLogger
projects.description: Drop-in audit logging for DiscordPHP bots — every gateway event, formatted and routed.

projects.name: NFG
projects.description: Note Form Generator — a dependency-free HTML/JS tool that turns inline JSON schemas into tabbed forms and exports a standalone page.
